report.summary: The report is well-sourced with 63 tagged claims, all supported except one claim about the construction market size (unsupported because the cited page does not explicitly state that figure for the construction market). One claim received a partial verdict because a descriptive detail (benefit of box-pushing technique) was not in the source. No untagged claims were found. The blocking count of 1 must be resolved before proceeding.
